packages.name: jftrade-backtest
packages.goOwner: pkg/backtest conservative-bar-v1 matching, fees, position accounting and result metrics
packages.cutover: the stage 3 offline go/shadow/rust selector rehearses rollback; the product switch remains a single jftrade-engine composition choice
packages.goDeleteWhen: the production Pine replay adapter maps the real event stream without loss, product behavior and recovery pass the observation window, native resource gates pass, and the rollback window closes

packages.name: jftrade-marketdata
packages.goOwner: internal/marketdata demand, freshness, cache and provider-neutral routing
packages.cutover: a single jftrade-engine provider-router composition choice after Stage 4 shadow qualification
packages.goDeleteWhen: provider capability, demand, cache freshness and switching differentials pass the observation window and Rust is the sole product owner

packages.name: jftrade-integration-marketdata-helper
packages.goOwner: internal/marketdataassets plus internal/app/apiserver/marketdataapp Python helper lifecycle and internal/integration/yfinance HTTP adapter
packages.cutover: jftrade-engine starts exactly one authenticated loopback helper and injects its adapter into jftrade-marketdata
packages.goDeleteWhen: asset materialization, readiness, retry, cancellation, shutdown and packaged helper smoke pass all native targets with no Go helper owner

packages.name: jftrade-integration-pine
packages.goOwner: pkg/strategy/pineworker host lifecycle and worker pool
packages.cutover: jftrade-engine owns the authenticated loopback worker pool while workers/pineworker retains PineTS execution
packages.goDeleteWhen: gRPC behavior, session pinning, restart recovery, asset verification and packaged worker lifecycle pass all native targets

packages.name: jftrade-integration-futu
packages.goOwner: internal/integration/futu and pkg/futu OpenD market-data protocol lifecycle
packages.cutover: jftrade-engine injects the OpenD adapter into jftrade-marketdata; Stage 5 separately owns trading commands
packages.goDeleteWhen: OpenD frame/protobuf mapping, quote-login health, subscription recovery and explicit live workflow pass before the Go market-data adapter is removed

packages.name: jftrade-engine
packages.goDeleteWhen: all capability owners have moved and the Go entrypoints have completed rollback qualification

packages.name: jftrade-kernel
packages.goOwner: pkg/bbgo/fixedpoint, pkg/bbgo/types and cross-domain value codecs
packages.cutover: versioned private DTO mappers assembled by jftrade-engine
packages.goDeleteWhen: all consuming capabilities pass the shared golden corpus and no Go owner imports the replaced codecs

packages.name: jftrade-broker
packages.cutover: consumer-defined broker ports assembled by jftrade-engine
packages.goDeleteWhen: market-data and trading consumers have moved and provider adapters no longer expose Go broker contracts

packages.name: jftrade-store-sqlite
packages.cutover: per-capability persistence ports assembled by jftrade-engine; stage 2 remains read-only
packages.goDeleteWhen: each capability has a single Rust write owner, migration/rollback evidence, and no Go query or migration consumer
